Subiect: Getting ready #3: Opening your commitment inbox

Conținut:

Hi there 👋,
 
Day three.
 
It's read enough now to start catching things.
 
Today: open your commitment inbox.
 
Every promise, decision and ask it finds goes in one place. The quote you said you'd send. The thing you agreed on a call. The
reply you owe from a Slack thread three days ago.
 
Everything in one place. Email, calendar, Slack, your call notes. Each one shows where it came from and what's next, so you can
click straight back to the original message.
 
Both sides of your life, without the pile. The client follow-up, the renewal, the school date. Filter by where it came from or
what's due, so you only ever look at the bit you want.
 



 
Have a look, then pick one and finish it. You'll find most of the work already done.
 
Open your inbox → [https://app.readywhen.ai/?utm_source=onboarding&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=onboarding_email_3]
 
Coming Next: Getting Stuff Done
 
Nadescha
